description: Use for "where in the body": the atlas body structures (organs and regions) that carry a molecular target: for CB1 and CB2 the qualitative receptor density (0 to 4, a teaching summary of the literature, not a measurement), other receptors listed for a structure, and the structures where a compound effect at this target is mapped, with the compound and its evidence grade. Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"target":"CB1"}.

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 99.

target.description: Target id, name or gene, for example "CB1" or "TRPV1".

name: list_structures_for_target
title: Body structures carrying a target
